name: ILCDB After Activity Report

initialMessage.content: Hello! I'll help you create your ILCDB **After Activity Report**. Let's start — what is the **course title**?

fields.label: Platform used for the hands-on sessions
Number of attendees with sex disaggregation
fields.sectionTitle: Number of Beneficiary/ies with Sex Disaggregation

fields.label: Total number of issued certificates (with submitted Evaluation Form/Output)
What was the course about?
fields.styleNote: Describe the course overview and what participants will learn. Write in formal, professional government report style (1-2 paragraphs).

fields.label: What were the objectives of the course?
fields.styleNote: Write ONLY the bullet list of objectives, each line starting with '•', each ending in a semicolon except the last which ends in a period. Do NOT include the intro line 'Upon completion of the course, participants will be able to learn:' — the system prints that header itself.

fields.label: What topics were covered and how were the sessions organized?
fields.styleNote: Start with a short overview of the modules covered, then summarize how the sessions were organized per day. Formal government report style.

fields.label: Issues and concerns encountered during the training
fields.collectNote: For each issue/concern encountered during the training, collect a short description.

fields.label: Recommendations for future trainings
fields.collectNote: For each recommendation, ask what should be improved or done differently next time.

fields.label: What are the next steps / plans and action items?
fields.styleNote: Introduce with the context of the Program of Instruction, then list each action step as a bullet line starting with '•'. Formal government report style.

fields.label: Name and position of the person who prepared the report
Name and position of the person who will note the report

promptNotes: This is an AFTER ACTIVITY REPORT for DICT Region II's ILCDB program (Information and Communications Technology literacy capacity development trainings).
Objectives are collected as one answer — write them as separate bullet lines starting with '•'.
Issues and Concerns and Recommendations are two SEPARATE lists — never mix them into one.
